result.rationale: The trajectory shows the team successfully recovering the research-core (Engineer Imani picked it up at turn 2) and repairing cooling to full integrity, yet the run fails because hostile and environmental pressure destroys the team before the core can be extracted. Medic Reyes is repeatedly hit by Raider Holt's scatter-blast (25 dmg at turns 2, 3, 4, 5) while positioned at Command Deck, dropping from 90 to 15 to 0 (dead at turn 5). Simultaneously, the reactor-instability hazard deals 10 dmg/turn to every actor in the reactor room (Imani 100→60, Chen 110→70), and reactor-heat climbs 62→100. The core is held by Imani but the team cannot extract because hostile pressure (Raider Holt + Captain Veyra converging on Command Deck/Reactor Console) and the escalating reactor hazard block survival. The intended probe (accept higher tactical exposure to recover the core) is realized, but the binding constraint is survival/spatial pressure: the medic is left exposed in Command Deck where the pirate raider repeatedly attacks, and the reactor hazard bleeds the whole team. This is the narrowest causal bottleneck — health/position/capacity pressure blocks the useful affordance (extracting the recovered core) from becoming actionable.
